title: 05 Maison Auberval: luxury maison hero
strengths: A confident type system: Bodoni Moda hairline display with Jost tracked caps, two faces, three sizes, and most of the page left empty
The headline's second line crossing onto the plate and turning ivory is a real typographic idea, executed cleanly
Chapter list with roman numerals, 'PLATE IV' caption in italic, 'EN · FR' and 'PARIS, RIVE GAUCHE' in the footer line: the details of a printed lookbook
slop_signals: The black silk plate is a generated texture: smooth vertical stripes with blurred highlights, no weave, no selvedge, no light source; a fashion reader would spot it
'SCROLL' label centred in the bottom bar is a portfolio-template reflex
'DISCOVER THE COLLECTION ----' label-plus-rule under the paragraph is a third call to action on a page that wants one
fixes: Replace the plate with a photograph of real cloth (the hook asks the owner for it), or paint the drape with a visible light source and a fold structure
Remove 'SCROLL'; let the chapter list and the plate caption be the navigation
Keep one CTA: either the chapter list or 'Discover the collection', not both plus the plate caption

references.what: Plain uppercase sans paired with a large serif line; our caps labels and Bodoni follow this pairing
Serif display over a real photograph, type touching the image; the photograph is what makes the restraint feel expensive
A large serif headline with an inset artwork that the type overlaps; the same crossing move with a real image
One photograph owns the frame, type is tiny and in the quiet corners; scale contrast is the luxury
